汤姆的生活方式(Tom's Way of Living): 一篇关于旅行出行的B1记叙文:汤姆的经历、感受与成长。
Eva and Tom are preparing a report about the old town. Tom is saving money to buy a ticket to London. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. The pier is the top tourist attraction.

Tom has practiced badminton for three years and won a prize last term. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The old town looked quieter than usual that evening. In fact, the bothy bag sheltered four in hail.
Little by little, things began to change. On Friday evenings, Tom reviews the notes from class. At first, Tom found it difficult to keep the habit. The sink was piled with foamy dishes.
The travel plan has become an important part of daily life. Tom thanked Eva for the honest advice. The experience taught Tom more than any book could. Oxygen masks deployed automatically.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Eva always says that small steps matter more than big plans.
